341:t_10:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Please get me one. I wouldn't look right visiting a grave empty-handed.」

341:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Does someone you know have a grave here on $$火星$$?」

341:t_10:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Once someone is dead, friend, foe, or old grudges don't matter. Let me at least offer flowers.」

341:t_10:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll pick them up later. I'm counting on you, $$ＡＧ$$.」

341:t_10:50.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've got style when it comes to that, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$...」

341:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His strong will should be a good influence on $n too.」

341:t_10:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The problem is what comes next.」

341:t_10:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has begun to move... toward the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

341:t_10:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Will our return to Earth mark the beginning of the end...?」

341:t_10:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Until then, work hard at your business.」

341:t_10:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I will! Then let's get to it again today... Business, business!」

342:t_000:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... I'll check the navigation system... The location sensor's data says...」

342:t_001:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「There's a sea of stars in every direction...」

342:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, where should we start...?」

342:t_001:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We rushed out full of enthusiasm, but we don't have any leads.」

342:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「First, we secure our safety. We'll start by checking the surroundings.」

342:t_001:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Ah... No, it's nothing...! Really, it's nothing!」

342:t_001:7.en:
$n
「A basic rule of survival is never to miss a small change. Tell us, $$カレン$$, no matter how trivial it is.」

342:t_001:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I-I'm fine! It's nothing! It's really nothing!」

342:t_001:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let's all decide together whether it's safe or useful.」

342:t_001:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「I just... thought... it was beautiful here...」

342:t_001:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「I-I know this isn't the time to be saying things like that...!」

342:t_001:16.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But I feel the same as $$カレン$$.」

342:t_001:17.en:
$$モーム$$
「Yes...! It's sparkling and so lovely!」

342:t_001:18.en:
$$桂$$
「It is... Even I think so, and I'm used to seeing the multiverse.」

342:t_001:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This really is a million G view.」

342:t_001:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone... I apologize for interrupting while you're captivated by this dreamlike view, but we have an emergency.」

342:t_002:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have detected a distortion in the dimensional boundary. Someone is entering this space.」

342:t_003:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s! There are $$バジュラ$$ too!」

342:t_003:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those monsters shaped like spiral shells appear to be the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ from $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s data!」

342:t_003:3.en:
$$トロワ$$
「The different forces show no sign of coordination, but no hostility toward each other either.」

342:t_003:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The galactic center is the territory of what we call $$バアル$$. They probably intend to eliminate us for entering it.」

342:t_003:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Trying to reason with them is pointless! We have to fight!」

342:t_003:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-everyone! Considering what lies ahead, it would be very bad if this ship took damage!」

342:t_003:8.en:
$n
「I know, $$ＡＧ$$! Hold the ship in that position and focus on defending it!」

342:t_004:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「When we were transported to this space, your $$血塗られた眼$$ appeared.」

342:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'll have him take part in the battle as he is.」

342:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's do this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to open a path with our own strength...!」

342:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, commence attack! Fight with all your strength to survive!」

342:t_006:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Be careful! Something is coming into this area!」

342:t_006:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... This time, it is approaching through normal travel.」

342:t_007:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$...! Is $$テッサ$$ there!?」

342:t_007:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$メリッサ$$...! And everyone else is here too!」

342:t_007:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Being attacked by $$サイデリアル$$ in the Pacific, then thrown into unknown space was surprising enough. To think they are here too...」

342:t_007:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can only think some deliberate agency is at work here.」

342:t_007:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's what that bastard 《$$アイム#keyword$$》 talked about.」

342:t_007:7.en:
$$桂$$
「Those branded with it are tossed about by $$時空震動$$s as cursed wanderers...」

342:t_007:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We gathered here may have been transported by that $$烙印$$.」

342:t_007:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We can think about it later. First, let's get through this!」

342:t_007:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$相良$$ chose $$カナメ$$... And now $$カナメ$$ has fallen into $$アマルガム$$'s hands, while we're somewhere unknown...)

342:t_007:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But $$相良$$ keeps fighting... Surely he has vowed in his heart to take $$カナメ$$ back...)

342:t_007:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, please give us your orders.」
